source_of_truth: ops/challenge/coordinator.json (event state); this file is the append-only outcome ledger
rules: Append-only: entries are never edited or deleted; corrections land as NEW entries referencing the entry they correct.
Every event outcome (submitted/not, placed/not) appends an entry at close.
Live events near deadline with no submission carry AT_RISK entries (gross_foregone 0 until close).
Totals block is derived from the entries and recomputed on each append (totals are not an entry).

LEDGER = 1ST PLACE ONLY (owner correction 2026-10-28): entries record ONLY the top (1st-place) award gross foregone; no expected_value_foregone, no win_probability anywhere in entries or totals. Totals = sum of 1st-place gross by form over non-superseded entries.
